entries.label: SELECT ... FROM research_item WHERE research_item.id IN (SELECT research_match.item_id FROM research_match JOIN research_watch ON research_watch.id = research_match.watch_id WHERE research_watch.owner_user_id = :owner_user_id_1) OR research_item.root_id IN (SELECT coalesce(research_item.root_id, research_match.item_id) AS coalesce_1 FROM research_match JOIN research_watch ON research_watch.id = research_match.watch_id JOIN research_item ON research_item.id = research_match.item_id WHERE research_watch.owner_user_id = :owner_user_id_2 AND research_watch.with_threads IS true) ORDER BY research_item.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, research_item.id LIMIT :param_1
SELECT ... FROM research_watch WHERE research_watch.id = :id_1 AND research_watch.owner_user_id = :owner_user_id_1
